title: ErrorResponseObject
description: An object that includes details about the error.

ErrorsArray.description: An array with information about the error.

code.description: A short string that represents the error.

message.description: A developer-facing message with more details about the error, not to be displayed to customers.

resource.description: The type of the Forage resource involved in the error.

ref.description: If applicable, the ten character reference hash of the Forage resource that caused the error. An empty string if no specific individual resource was involved.

details.description: Additional details about the error, if applicable.
